title: The Brucella abortus two-component system response regulator BvrR binds to three DNA regulatory boxes in the upstream region of omp25.
authors: Castillo-Zeledon, Amanda; Rivas-Solano, Olga; Villalta-Romero, Fabian; Gomez-Espinoza, Olman; Moreno, Edgardo; Chaves-Olarte, Esteban; Guzman-Verri, Caterina
one_liner_zh: 该文研究布鲁氏菌双组分系统调控因子BvrR与omp25启动子区三个DNA结合盒的互作，包含分子对接预测，但以实验为主、对接分析较浅，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可借鉴。
abstract: Brucella abortus is a facultative extracellular-intracellular bacterial zoonotic pathogen worldwide. It is also a major cause of abortion in bovines, generating economic losses. The two-component regulatory system BvrR/BvrS modulates the expression of genes required to transition from extracellular to intracellular lifestyles. However, few regulatory regions of BvrR direct target genes have been studied. In this study, we characterized the regulatory region of omp25, a gene encoding an outer membrane protein that is positively regulated by TCS BvrR/BvrS. By omp25-lacZ reporter fusions and beta-galactosidase activity assays, we found that the region between-262 and + 127 is necessary for transcriptional activity, particularly a 111-bp long fragment located from-262 to -152. In addition, we demonstrated the binding of P-BvrR to three sites within the -140 to +1 region. Two of these sites were delimited between -18 to +1 and - 99 to -76 by DNase I footprinting and called DNA regulatory boxes 1 and 2, respectively. The third binding site (box 3) was delimited from -140 to -122 by combining EMSA and fluorescence anisotropy results. A molecular docking analysis with HDOCK predicted BvrR-DNA interactions between 11, 13, and 12 amino acid residue-nucleotide pairs in boxes 1, 2, and 3, respectively. A manual sequence alignment of the three regulatory boxes revealed the presence of inverted and non-inverted repeats of five to eight nucleotides, partially matching DNA binding motifs previously described for BvrR. We propose that P-BvrR binds directly to up to three regulatory boxes and probably interacts with other transcription factors to regulate omp25 expression. This gene regulation model could apply to other BvrR target genes and to orthologs of the TCS BvrR/BvrS and Omp25 in phylogenetically closed Rhizobiales.
abstract_zh: 流产布鲁氏菌（Brucella abortus）是一种兼性胞外-胞内细菌性人畜共患病原体，遍布全球。它也是牛流产的主要原因，造成经济损失。双组分调控系统BvrR/BvrS调节从胞外到胞内生活方式转变所需基因的表达。然而，BvrR直接靶基因的调控区域研究甚少。在本研究中，我们表征了omp25的调控区域，该基因编码一种外膜蛋白，受TCS BvrR/BvrS正调控。通过omp25-lacZ报告基因融合和β-半乳糖苷酶活性测定，我们发现-262至+127之间的区域对转录活性是必需的，特别是位于-262至-152的111-bp长片段。此外，我们证明了P-BvrR在-140至+1区域内的三个位点结合。其中两个位点通过DNase I足迹法限定于-18至+1和-99至-76，分别称为DNA调控盒1和2。第三个结合位点（盒3）通过结合EMSA和荧光各向异性结果限定于-140至-122。使用HDOCK进行的分子对接分析预测了BvrR-DNA相互作用，分别在盒1、2和3中涉及11、13和12个氨基酸残基-核苷酸对。对三个调控盒的手动序列比对揭示了五至八个核苷酸的反向和非反向重复，部分匹配先前描述的BvrR DNA结合基序。我们提出P-BvrR直接结合至多达三个调控盒，并可能与其他转录因子相互作用以调节omp25表达。该基因调控模型可能适用于其他BvrR靶基因以及系统发育上接近的根瘤菌目（Rhizobiales）中TCS BvrR/BvrS和Omp25的直系同源物。
